messages.text:
I’m going to add the runtime now: `./executable` for the Python port and a local differential verifier under `.tura/script` that compares live official-binary results.

The acceptance condition is observable equivalence, so the verifier will run both programs on generated valid and invalid CLI/file cases instead of asserting stored outputs.
